steps.speaker: Misfortune Incarnate
steps.content: I'll admit, you've made it further than I expected. Unfortunately for you...

steps.speaker: Misfortune Incarnate
steps.content: ...these little toys of yours are barely worth swallowing.
It opens its mouth. Several wooden fragments spill out, coated in viscous Mania, hitting the ground with wet, sticky sounds.
Norma's chest tightens, but her expression stays stone-cold. One look at the debris tells her everything. Those are her beacons, destroyed.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: If you're trying to taunt me, at least study the humans you despise so much.

steps.speaker: Misfortune Incarnate
steps.content: ...Is that so? From where I stand, you're the one putting on a show.
Norma puts distance between herself and Misfortune Incarnate, but the Mania saturation is overwhelming. Data floods her vision in an explosion of numbers. There is no opening to exploit.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: Looks like... I have to hold out a little while longer.
She straightens her glasses and watches the dark shadow closing in.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: This is well outside my job description, Chief. Please ensure hazard pay is included in the next quarter's budget.
